pseudemys.translation: [网络] 彩龟属；伪龟属；甜甜圈龟属

pseudemys concinna.translation: [网络] 甜甜圈龟；河伪龟；二名法

pseudepigrapha.definition: n 52 texts written between 200 BC and AD 200 but ascribed to various prophets and kings in the Hebrew scriptures; many are apocalyptic in nature
pseudepigrapha.translation: [pl. ](=Pseudepigrapha )圣经的模拟[伪仿]作品(所写的虽是圣经中的人物但不是圣典的正经)

pseudepigraphic.definition:
a. Alt. of Pseudepigraphic
a. Of or pertaining to pseudepigraphy.

pseudepigraphous.definition: a. Inscribed with a false name.

pseudepigraphy.definition: n. The ascription of false names of authors to works.
pseudepigraphy.translation: n. 作者归属错误( 指把某人的著作误认为是别人所作)

pseudery.translation: n. <口> ( 假充有知识的) 装腔作势言词( 或表达方式)

pseudesthesia.translation: [医] 幻觉, 联觉, 牵连感觉
